pie: h₂yúHeni pótni ǵʰwḗrm̥ h₂isḱóh₂. h₁mé wédʰe h₁mé-kʷe spéḱye. méǵʰye h₁ím woydéye mē-kʷe bʰugyéh₁t. méne h₃ókʷih₁ h₁ím kʷḱih₁tā́m. h₁ím h₁pyéh₁m̥ tébʰye-kʷe déh₃nom dédeh₃oh₂.
english: Young mistress, I am seeking a wild beast. Lead me and look upon me! Show it to me, and may it not flee. May my eyes catch sight of it. May I seize it, and I shall give you a gift.

pie: dyéw ph₂ter h₁uséwōm déh₃tor. h₁yós h₂uséy ḱlutóm h₁nómn̥ dʰéh₁s. h₁yós n̥sméy lewbʰéh₂m léwkm̥ dʰéh₁s. túH n̥sméy upér tetónth₂e túH deywṓm h₃rḗǵs. n̥smé ḱludʰí wékʷesh₂ nos ḱludʰí. dʰewséh₂ nos péh₂wr̥-kʷe h₂lékse.
english: Father Sky, giver of good things! You who set a famous name for Dawn, you who made dear light for us: you are stretched above us. You are the king of the gods. Hear us, Father, hear our words! Protect our animals and our fire!

pie: léwkm̥ dedr̥ḱmé mudmé-kʷe. léwka n̥sméy bʰéh₂os h₁áys. tébʰye déh₃nom dedh₃més. n̥smé h₂ew gʷm̥dʰí tetr̥pmé. h₁wésuh₂ nos wékʷesh₂ ḱlutéh₂ h₁syéh₁t. n̥sméy priHós h₁sdʰí n̥smé mē linékʷs.
english: We have seen the light, and we became glad. Bright one, you gave us light. We give you a gift. Come to us again. We are satisfied. May our good words be heard! Be dear to us, do not leave us!

pie: nékʷtbʰos h₂éwsōs-kʷe méǵh₂ih₂ swésōr. kʷsép léyts pótni-kʷe h₁íh₂m̥ sékʷeth₂er. h₁rudʰéh₁si h₂éweyes-kʷe sth₂ént. kʷsép-ge sḱih₃wóm bʰéresi. pótni lewbʰéh₂m léwkm̥ bʰéresi. swésorh₁e n̥smé kʷsépi ph₂stóm.
english: Night and Dawn, great sisters! Night, you go away, and you, mistress, follow her. You glow red, and the birds rise. Night, indeed, you bring darkness. Mistress, you bring dear light. Protect us, sisters, in the night!

pie: léwbʰa pótni méne suHnús ḱéyor gʷʰért-kʷe. méne suHnúm memn̥dʰí. h₁ím spéḱye h₁ím-kʷe h₂lékse. méne suHnús sth₂yéh₁t mē-kʷe mr̥yéh₁t. wódr̥ ph₃yéh₁t h₁édih₁t-kʷe. pótni tébʰye h₂egʷnóm déh₃oh₂.
english: Dear mistress, my son lies, and has become warm. Remember my son! Look upon him and guard him! May my son stand up, and may he not die. May he drink water, and may he eat. I shall give you a lamb, mistress.

pie: nókʷts h₂éwsōs-kʷe swésorh₁e h₁stā́m. nókʷts dʰǵʰémi gʷm̥sḱét. nu h₂éwsōs swéh₂m swésorm̥ sékʷeto h₁rudʰéh₁t-kʷe h₂yéwHō-kʷe h₁ést. nókʷts gʷm̥yóntih₂m h₁íh₂m̥ widét bʰéwgt-kʷe. swésorh₁e ne ǵn̥h₃tā́m.
english: Night and Dawn were sisters. Night was walking on the earth. Then Dawn followed her own sister, and glowed red, and was young. Night saw her coming and fled. The sisters did not meet.

pie: h₁regʷesyét. nókʷts gʷémt wiHrṓs-kʷe l̥gʰént. nu sóh₂wl̥ ḱémh₂t dʰubʰróm-kʷe wódr̥ séngʷt. swépnos h₁íd h₁épt plówyoh₁-kʷe kʷsépi yéh₂t. nu h₂yuHénih₂ déywih₂ h₂én h₁ért sékʷt-kʷe. sth₂dʰí. nu h₁íd bʰéwdʰt. h₁íd bʰéh₂esh₁ woséyet. h₂wést.
english: It was getting dark. Night arrived, and men lay down. Then the sun became tired, and sank into the deep water. Sleep seized it, and it travelled in a ship through the night. Then the young goddess arrived there, and said: "Stand up!" It woke. She clothed it in radiance. It dawned.

pie: wósr̥ gʷegʷóme gʷʰért-kʷe. snígʷʰs tinéh₁ti wódr̥ drémt. gʷénh₂es péyh₂tu pékʷonti. wĺ̥kʷōs n̥ḱént h₂éweyes nisdóns démonti. lewkóm n̥sméy priHóm h₁syéh₁s. téwe léwkesi gʷíh₃woyh₁me.
english: Spring has come, and it became warm. The snow melts, the water runs. The women cook the nourishing food. The wolves vanish. The birds build nests. Bright one, may you be dear to us. May we live in your light!

pie: h₂yuHénih₂ kʷís diwés gʷm̥yéti? h₁íh₂ h₂éwsōs ḱéyweh₂ déywih₂. kúdʰe h₁éyti kúdʰe-kʷe stestóh₂e? h₁íh₂ h₁éyti h₂óweyes-kʷe h₁íh₂m̥ sékʷontor. pr̥h₂wós kʷís h₁íh₂m̥ widét? pr̥h₂wós poh₂imḗn h₁íh₂m̥ widét. ḱéyweh₂ déywih₂ n̥sméy lukyéh₁t.
english: Who is she, the young one who comes from the sky? She is Dawn, the dear goddess. Where does she go, and where does she stand? She goes, and the sheep follow her. Who was first to see her? The shepherd was first to see her. May the dear goddess shine for us!

pie: gʷr̥Hḗi h₂ówis, kʷésyo wlh₂néH ne (h₁é) est, h₁éḱwons spéḱet, h₁oinom gʰe gʷr̥Húm wóǵʰom wéǵʰontm̥ h₁oinom-kʷe méǵHm bʰórom, h₁oinom-kʷe ǵʰménm̥ Hṓḱu bʰérontm̥.
english: A sheep that had no wool saw horses, one of them pulling a heavy wagon, one carrying a big load, and one carrying a man quickly.

pie: h₃érō úd yéh₂t. sóh₂wl̥ swṓys h₃kʷbʰís spéḱyet. nu h₁íd h₃r̥néy sékʷt. kʷís h₁mé spéḱyeti? wérh₁t. h₁eǵóh₂ twé spéḱyoh₂. méne h₃ókʷih₁ ne dedwiyḗr h₁eǵóh₂-kʷe ne bʰebʰóyh₂h₂e. nu sóh₂wl̥ h₃éronm̥ ǵnéh₃t h₁ésmey-kʷe ḱlutóm h₁nómn̥ dʰéh₁t. h₁éy h₂wéyōm h₃rḗǵs.
english: The eagle was going upwards. He kept looking at the sun with his own eyes. Then it spoke to the eagle: "Who looks at me?" He spoke: "I look at you. My eyes are not afraid, and I am not afraid." Then the sun knew the eagle, and set a famous name for him. The eagle is the king of birds.

pie: wiHrós bʰoydʰéh₂m dʰéh₁t. dyḗws h₁íh₂m̥ ḱléwt h₁íh₂m̥-kʷe kʷéḱt. só swéh₂i bʰréh₂term̥ dʰréwgʰt. nu mért. wĺ̥kʷōs h₁ím h₁édn̥t. h₁yós bʰréh₂term̥ dʰréwgʰt sóh₂wl̥ tóm dedórḱe. só ne gʷíh₃weti.
english: A man made a pledge. Sky heard it, and caught sight of it. But the man deceived his brother. Then he died. The wolves ate him. Whoever deceives a brother, the sun sees him. He does not live.

pie: tósyo ǵʰéwtorm̥ prēḱst: "súHnus moy ǵn̥h₁yetōd!"
english: He asked his priest: "May a son be born to me!"

pie: eḱwos wewekur, "ḱludʰe, owei! ḱerd angʰetai widontbʰyos: ǵʰm̥on, potis, wl̥nam owiyōm kʷr̥neti soi gʷʰermom westrom; owibʰyos kʷe wl̥nā ne esti".
english: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

pie: sóh₂wl̥ kóryom h₁imés n̥sméy pró ih₂dʰí. n̥smé h₂lékse gʰóstins-kʷe unih₁mé. polh₁éwes gʰósteyes n̥sméd bʰugih₁ént. n̥smé gʰostíbʰos spr̥dʰí. n̥sméy polh₁úns misdʰóns h₁áydʰi. péh₂wr̥ h₁rih₁mé mē-kʷe m̥rih₁mé.
english: Sun, we are going to war: go before us! Guard us, and may we overpower the enemies. May the many enemies flee from us. Rescue us from the enemies! Give us many prizes! May we arrive at the fire, and may we not die.

pie: péh₂wr̥ h₂nr̥bʰós ne h₁ést studént-kʷe. nu h₂yuHénih₂ gʷḗn sóh₂wl̥ úd spéḱyet. n̥sméy péh₂wr̥ duh₃dʰí. nu tód h₁íh₂m̥ ḱléwt h₁íd-kʷe séh₁t. h₁íd h₁épt h₁íd-kʷe ḱóymom bʰéret. gʷnéh₂bʰos déh₃nom h₁opéyont h₁ésmi-kʷe sísdont gʷʰrént-kʷe. gʷnéh₂s ḱḗr tetórpe. péyh₂tu ph₂wéni pékʷet h₁édn̥t-kʷe. gʷnéh₂s ḱléwos ń̥dʰgʷʰitom.
english: There was no fire for men, and they became cold. Then a young woman looked up at the sun. "Give us fire!" It heard her, and let it go. She seized it and carried it to the village. They gave the woman a gift. They sat at the fire, and became warm. She cooked the nourishing food at the fire, and they ate. The woman's heart is satisfied. The woman's fame is imperishable.

pie: h₂éwsos swā́s h₂ówins pl̥th₂enóm h₂éǵrom wédʰoh₂. h₁íh₂n̥s-ge wĺ̥kʷōd h₂lékse. wĺ̥kʷos h₁íh₂n̥s mē gʷm̥yéh₁t. méne h₂óweyes pl̥h₁éwih₂es h₁sih₁ént. h₂óyu gʷíh₃woyh₁ent mē-kʷe m̥rih₁ént. méne priHós ḱwṓ h₁ím kʷḱyéh₁t mē kʷis lelikʷyéh₁t. léwbʰa déywi tébʰye h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m dédeh₃oh₂.
english: Dawn, I lead my own sheep to the wide field. Protect them, indeed, from the wolf! May the wolf not come to them! May my sheep be many. May they live a long time, and may they not die. May my dear dog see the wolf. May none be missing. I shall give you wool, dear goddess.

pie: h₃rḗǵs h₃mígʰleh₂i gʷm̥sḱét. dwóh₁ ḱwónh₁e h₁ím sékʷonto h₃sléydʰt-kʷe. h₃mígʰleh₂ tgéwih₂. tréset. nu HréwdHt. léwkm̥ h₁áydʰi. h₂wést h₃mígʰleh₂-kʷe bʰéwgt. nu léwkm̥ widét ḱóymom-kʷe wéyḱt. h₂uséy moysóm déh₃t. h₁íh₂ h₁ésmey h₁wésu ḱléwos h₁opéyet. nu h₁ésyeh₂ey ḱléytreh₂m démet.
english: A king was walking in the mist. Two dogs followed him, and he went astray. The mist was thick. He trembled. Then he cried out: "Give light!" It dawned, and the mist fled. Then he saw the light, and entered the village. He gave Dawn a ram. She gave him good fame. Then he built a shelter for her.

pie: dyéw ḱludʰí sóh₂wl̥ widéh₁ye. méǵh₂ih₂m-ge bʰoydʰéh₂s dʰéh₁m̥. h₁yód ḱéywom dʰréwgʰoh₂ dyḗws me moréyoyh₁t. h₁yód h₁ím mē dʰréwgʰoh₂ gʷíh₃woyh₁m̥.
english: Sky, hear! Sun, see! I have indeed made a great pledge. If I deceive a friend, may Sky kill me. If I do not deceive him, may I live.

pie: dyéw dʰéǵʰōm-kʷe méǵh₂ih₂ méh₂tēr. deywṓs usméd ǵn̥h₁yónto. yúH pl̥th₂enṓs yúH-kʷe dʰubʰrṓs. wérsenn̥s h₂egʷnóns-kʷe h₂élete. pérkʷus h₁entér stestóh₂e. ǵénh₁torh₁e n̥smé ḱlutóm. suHnúns nos ḱwónn̥s-kʷe ph₂stóm.
english: Sky and Earth, the great mother! The gods were born from you. You are wide, and you are deep. You nourish the male animals and the lambs. Between you stands the oak. Hear us, parents! Protect our sons and our dogs!

pie: h₂éwsōs swóns gʷṓs pl̥th₂enóm h₂éǵrom h₂éǵet. bʰṓr gʷṓs h₁épt h₁íns-kʷe h₂ewlóm ǵʰéyt. nu h₂éwsōs ne léwkt h₁regʷesyét-kʷe. nu priHós h₁ésyeh₂s ḱwṓ gʷṓs h₂isḱét h₁íns-kʷe h₂ewlóy widét. h₁íh₂m̥ drémt. nu h₂ewlóm h₁ért. bʰṓr tréset bʰéwgt-kʷe. gʷṓs spért h₁íns-kʷe lowkóm h₁éǵʰs wédʰet léwks-kʷe léh₂pt.
english: Dawn drove her own cattle to the wide field. A thief seized the cattle and drove them into a hollow. Then Dawn did not shine, and it was getting dark. Then her dear dog sought the cattle and found them in the hollow. He ran to her. She arrived at the hollow. The thief trembled, and fled. She freed the cattle, and led them out into the light, and light flashed up.

pie: dyéw ph₂ter tébʰye moysóm dedh₃més. h₁ím h₁áyso n̥sméy-kʷe wódr̥ duh₃dʰí. tébʰye h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m h₂éh₂usom-kʷe bʰérōmes. tr̥syómes dʰewséh₂-kʷe nos tr̥syéti. h₂éǵroysu nos h₂wr̥sdʰí dʰoHnéh₂ h₂uksyéh₁t. dʰewséh₂-ge nos mē mr̥yéh₁t.
english: Father Sky, we give you a ram. Take it, and give us water! We shall bring you wool and gold. We are thirsty, and our animals are thirsty. Rain on our fields, and may the grain grow up! May our animals, indeed, not die.

pie: sóh₂wl̥ diwés h₃ókʷ h₁yód h₂n̥rṓm ḱérdh₂ wóydth₂e. h₁yód HeHḱúns h₁éḱwons yéwgs h₁yód dʰewséh₂ gʷʰr̥néwsi. h₁yód snígʷʰm̥ tinéh₁si h₁yód dʰoHnéh₂m pékʷesi. n̥sméy h₂ew l̥h₂pdʰí n̥sméy léwkm̥ h₁áydʰi.
english: Sun, eye of Sky! You who know the hearts of men, you who yoke the swift horses, you who warm the animals, you who melt the snow, you who ripen the grain, shine for us again, give us light!

pie: tgéwih₂ snígʷʰs pr̥kʷéwi ḱéyo wĺ̥kʷōs-kʷe wóyḱom h₁rént. h₂néres ph₂wéni sédyont. nu wósr̥ h₁ludʰét gʷʰért-kʷe. snígʷʰs tinéh₁t drémt-kʷe. n̥ḱént. nu wiHrṓs wóyḱōd linkʷént swéh₂-kʷe dʰewséh₂ pl̥th₂enóm h₂éǵrom wédʰet. gʷénh₂es péyh₂tu pékʷont. h₂éweyes nisdóns pr̥kʷéwi démont. gʷʰéros h₁éymos h₁wésu.
english: Thick snow lay on the oak, and the wolves arrived at the settlement. Men sat at the fire. Then spring arrived, and it became warm. The snow melted, and ran. They vanished. The men left the settlement and led their animals to the wide field. The women cooked the nourishing food. The birds built nests in the oak. Warm weather is good for them.

pie: h₂éwsos méǵʰye suHnúm h₁opéye. h₁éy Hwr̥dʰyéh₁t h₂óyu-kʷe gʷíh₃woyh₁t. h₁éy wiHrós h₁syéh₁t h₁éy h₁léwdʰeros h₁syéh₁t. h₁ésyo h₁nómn̥ ḱlutóm h₁syéh₁t. péyh₂tu h₁édih₁t sh₂yéh₁t-kʷe. tébʰye h₂egʷnóm h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m-kʷe déh₃oh₂.
english: Dawn, give me a son! May he become strong, and may he live a long time. May he be a hero. May he be free. May his name be famous. May he eat nourishing food, and may he be sated. I shall give you a lamb and wool.

pie: sh₂wéns kʷékʷlos Hrumptó. nu h₁íd wérh₁t. dyéw ph₂ter méne kʷékʷlom kʷḱdʰí. nu yemHóh₁ h₁ésyo wókʷm̥ ḱlutā́m gʷh₂tā́m-kʷe. HeHḱéwes h₁éḱwōs sth₂éh₁yont dʰm̥bʰént-kʷe. h₁regʷesyét. kʷékʷlom h₂réydʰetām HeHḱúns-kʷe h₁éḱwons yugtā́m. h₁éy solh₂wós bʰúHt Hwérdʰt-kʷe. h₂ew gʷéh₂t léwks-kʷe h₁ért. yemHóh₁ n̥sméy ḱéywoh₁.
english: The wheel of the sun broke. Then it spoke: "Father Sky, behold my wheel!" The twins heard his voice and came. The swift horses stood, and were astonished. It was getting dark. They put the wheel in order, and they yoked the swift horses. It became whole, and became strong. It went again, and light arrived. The twins are dear to us.

pie: h₂éwsōs pr̥h₂wéh₂ sóh₂wl̥-kʷe h₁íh₂m̥ sékʷetor. h₁íh₂ pró yéh₂ti h₁íd-kʷe énu h₁éyti. h₁íh₂ h₂réweti h₁íd-kʷe n̥sméy priHóm. h₁yód h₁r̥sḱétes sth₂mé-ge.
english: Dawn is first, and the sun follows her. She goes before, and it comes after. She glows, and it is dear to us. We, indeed, rise when they come.

pie: h₁regʷesyéti kʷséps-kʷe gʷm̥yéti. sóh₂wl̥ wódr̥ Hn̥dʰí séngʷs. ph₂ter n̥smé nékʷtbʰos h₂lékse. l̥gʰih₁mé swépnos-kʷe n̥smé h₁pyéh₁t. ḱwṓ nos ḱléytreh₂m h₂léksoyh₁t. pérkʷus n̥smé ḱéloyh₁t. bʰudʰih₁mé léwkm̥-kʷe h₂ew dedr̥ḱih₁mé.
english: It is getting dark, and night is coming. Sun, you sank into the water below. Father, guard us in the night! May we lie down, and may sleep seize us. May our dog guard the shelter. May the oak cover us. May we wake, and may we see the light again.
